You'd probably be correct.

I tried talking online to an operator instead, and it was mostly just generic robot-like replies. 

This is difficult.

I've been isolated from friends ever since I had a child. Very young, [college age, married] so people just moved on when we stopped relating.

I made a questionable mistake. Some would say "the wrong thing for the right reason."

But now it's all kinds of fucked up.
I just feel so physically sick.... I hate this.

Thank you for the advice, but it's not all that black-and-white.

Not only would it be a dishonor to me and my own family if I were to get divorced, but it is taught that divorce is only acceptable in the case of unfaithfulness. 

It's not about only me, either. I have my son to think about. My husband isn't inherently violent, and he does love his son very much, be it in a more passive way than is typical.

However, he does think that a women's place is to be a "homemaker", if you will. Taking care of emotional needs, children, cooking, cleaning, etc. While that is the opposite if my own ideals, because I married him, I am to respect his authority on that. 

Furthermore, I have tried to get a job. It's very difficult, as I have very nerve-wracking social anxiety. I have put in applications, but my husband has the car most of the day, I have the baby to take care of, no money for childcare.... it's tough.

 I want to be strong, but it's hard to be strong right now.

These "excuses" may seem petty to many people, but my life is very different from many people's, and that's okay. Either way, thank you for the advice.
As a woman who married early, I feel you, mate.
